title: Stuffed Chicken Breast Bonanza
description: Extremely versatile, chicken breasts are protein rich and easily batch cooked. Make extra each week to slice for sandwiches, add to salads, pasta or grain bowls or cubed for a perfect pre-bed protein snack. Adding anti-inflammatory spices, herbs and veggies increase overall nutrition and flavour for a great meal supporting your training and recovery.

ingredients.name: sea salt and fresh ground pepper

instructions.text: Line a baking sheet with parchment
With a sharp knife cut a deep horizontal slit through thickest part of the breast but do not cut all the way through (see picture)
Open and season with garlic, salt and pepper to taste
Stuff the rest of ingredients into the breast (divided between the 4 breasts). Press the chicken breast back together to hold the filling inside
Heat oil in a skillet on medium high and carefully sear each breast until lightly golden (~2 min/side)
Set chicken on baking sheet into oven for approximately 20 minutes (do not overcook)
